dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /ivy

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

RUN python -m pytest tests/ -v --tb=short

CMD ["python", "-c", "import ivy; print('Ivy framework successfully imported')"]
explanation: Requirements include core ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow) for Ivy's backend abstraction, testing/formatting tools (pytest, black, flake8), documentation dependencies (Sphinx suite), and common data science libraries. Dockerfile uses slim Python image, installs build tools for compiling dependencies, runs tests after copying code, and includes a health check command.
